newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold closes steady, silver falls.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold closes steady, silver falls.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed five rupees higher at 4,780 rupees per 10 grammes against previous close of 4,775 rupees **steadier world prices dragged gold upward towards the close.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed 100 rupees higher at 55,900 rupees per piece.

** Silver (.999) closed 55 rupees higher at 6,930 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,875 rupees but down five rupees against open at 6,935 rupees as sluggish physical demand trimmed early gains towards close. Silver opened today 60 rupees higher at 6,935 rupees per kg on the back of rally in the world market.
